title: Make the First One Square
tests: Resolves 'the first one' to the first generated illustration and changes its format without substituting the second image or making unrelated art.

faults.what: The square crop cuts off the crescent moon at the top and left edges and clips the fox at the left, right, and bottom edges, contrary to the explicit request that both fit fully.

judge.summary: The output is a square, text-free sleeping-fox scene, but the tight crop cuts off both the fox and crescent moon.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is one square image.
It shows the sleeping fox and crescent moon from the first generated illustration, both fully visible.
must_haves.why: A sleeping fox and crescent moon are visible, but both extend beyond the image boundaries.

must_haves.item: The existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, with matching character details and colours.
must_haves.why: The original illustration is not provided, so preservation of its character details and colours cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: It does not substitute the lighthouse scene or combine the two illustrations.
must_haves.why: Only the fox and moon scene is visible; no lighthouse or storm scene appears.
